privileged.modules/client-actions/code-attempt.ts: One try of an emailed code on the one action the link's token or the portal's own view named: counts the guess on that row, gives it back, locks the row past the total, writes its trail event. Nothing else is read or written.
privileged.modules/client-actions/portal-code.ts: Writes the code-sent trail event of the one action the portal person's own view showed them and whose invited address is theirs (portalDecideGate, read as the portal role first).
